player_character_data.name: Cain
features: Sovereign Logic: Spend 5 Sorcery Points to force any d20 roll to be a Natural 20.
Infinite Mana Well: Spell slots of level 1-5 are never consumed.
Gestalt Mastery: Proficiency in all saving throws and all skills.
Apostle's Blessing (Max Level): Immunity to Charmed, Frightened, and Exhaustion.
Reality Warp: You may cast any spell with a casting time of 1 action as a bonus action instead.
Divine Portfolio: Space-Time Logic (Manipulate space-time laws locally in a 120ft aura, once per day)

Cain's Sovereign artifacts, the Severance of Fate and the Aegis of the Seven Pillars, grant absolute offense and defense, including spatial reach and kinetic reflection.

Following the Holy Land incident, the Royal Court of Esfort has acknowledged Cain as a being of Sovereign power, shifting the kingdom's strategic focus toward the final confrontation with the Evil God Aaron.
Cain successfully used his divine presence to reassure King Rex of his humanity and loyalty, softening the crown's fear of his Sovereign power.

Hinata Lyra Marineford has requested Cain's help to deal with a fragment of the Evil God Aaron that is corrupting the Forbidden Archive beneath the Grand Cathedral.

Dalmatia confirmed the Pope was assassinated by a Shadow Infiltrator of Aaron, while a fragment of the Evil God has begun corrupting the Forbidden Archive beneath Marineford.
Cain has begun his ascension to Level 21 (Divine Tier) within the Grand Cathedral of Marineford, feeling his Sovereign power expand to match the impending threat of Aaron's fragment.
